segments.text: Alright, thanks everyone for joining. Agenda today is three things: the Q3 release scope, the payment bug from last week, and hiring. Let's start with scope.
So for Q3 the big items are offline mode, the redesigned onboarding, and push notifications. My worry is we can't do all three well before the September freeze.
I agree. Offline mode is the one users keep asking for in reviews. I'd rather ship offline mode solid than ship all three half-done.
Okay, then let's make the call: offline mode and onboarding are in for Q3, push notifications moves to Q4. Everyone good with that?
Works for me. That takes the pressure off the backend team too.
Good. Priya, can you update the roadmap doc to reflect push notifications slipping to Q4? And add a note on why, so support knows what to tell users.
Yep, I'll update the roadmap by end of day tomorrow.
Next, the payment bug. We had that report of double charges on Android. Rahul, where are we on it?
We found the root cause. It's a retry that fires when the network drops mid-transaction, so the charge goes through twice. Fix is basically an idempotency key on the payment request.
How risky is that change? Payments is the last place I want a surprise.
Low risk if we test it properly. I'll have the fix in review by Thursday, and I want QA to run the full payment regression suite before it ships. No shortcuts on this one.
Agreed, full regression before release. Rahul, please also write up the incident so we have it documented for the postmortem.
Will do. I'll send the incident writeup by Friday.
Last thing, hiring. We're still short one mobile engineer. Do we have budget approved for the role or is that still open?
That's still open actually. I need to confirm with finance whether the headcount carries over from Q2. I'm not certain, so let me check before we post the role.
Okay. Let's not post the job until that's confirmed. Meena, can you follow up with finance on the headcount this week?
Sure, I'll reach out to finance and report back in next week's sync.
Great. So to recap: offline mode and onboarding for Q3, payment fix by Thursday with full regression, and we confirm hiring budget before posting. Thanks all.

summary.tldr: The team locked Q3 scope to offline mode and redesigned onboarding, deferring push notifications to Q4 to avoid shipping three features half-done. The Android double-charge bug was root-caused to a network retry and will be fixed with an idempotency key, gated behind a full payment regression suite. Hiring for the open mobile engineer role is paused until finance confirms the headcount carries over from Q2.

key_decisions.decision: Q3 scope is offline mode and redesigned onboarding; push notifications is deferred to Q4.
The payment fix must pass the full payment regression suite before it ships.
Do not post the open mobile engineer role until finance confirms the headcount.

action_items.task: Update the roadmap doc to move push notifications to Q4, with a note explaining why for the support team.
Put the payment idempotency-key fix up for review.
Write up the payment incident for the postmortem.
Follow up with finance on whether the mobile engineer headcount carries over from Q2, and report back.

open_questions: Does the mobile engineer headcount carry over from Q2, or is new budget needed?
